name: Secret Level
description: Adult animated series of original short stories which are set within the worlds of beloved video games. Each episode serves as a gateway to a new adventure, unlocking exciting worlds from beloved gaming classics and highly anticipated new titles.

videos.title: Honoring the Source Material
videos.overview: "Secret Level" showrunners Tim Miller and Dave Wilson on the importance of staying true to the game's lore and IP.

videos.title: Capturing the Moment
videos.overview: A glimpse inside the cutting edge capture process used to create "Secret Level".

videos.title: Beyond the Map
videos.overview: Tim Miller and Dave Wilson dive into the creation of Secret Level, their groundbreaking anthology series that celebrates and honors the world of gaming.

videos.title: Dungeons & Dragons: The Queen's Cradle
videos.overview: On the hunt for a dragon cult, a band of adventurers rescues a boy who's haunted by a sinister force.

videos.title: Sifu: It Takes a Life
videos.overview: A young martial artist bent on revenge learns the true cost of his obsession.

videos.title: New World: The Once and Future King
videos.overview: A conquering king washes ashore on a mysterious island with no army and no clue. He may need an eternity to find his purpose.

videos.title: Unreal Tournament: Xan
videos.overview: After revolting against their corporate overlords, a group of mining robots is condemned to fight for survival in deadly arena combat.

videos.title: Warhammer 40,000: And They Shall Know No Fear
videos.overview: In the grim darkness of the far future, a genetically-engineered warrior who has served on the front lines for centuries confronts his legacy, as his squad hunts down a mutant sorcerer.

videos.title: PAC-MAN: Circle
videos.overview: Trapped in a vast maze and pursued by ghosts, a mysterious entity summons a warrior to help it escape.

videos.title: Crossfire: Good Conflict
videos.overview: As a looming storm approaches, two rival mercenary groups collide. Driven by their vision of the greater good, the sides face off, their lives hanging in the balance.

videos.title: Armored Core: Asset Management
videos.overview: In a frostbitten frontier world, a legendary mech pilot learns his latest mission might hold the key to the demons that have haunted him for decades.

videos.title: The Outer Worlds: The Company We Keep
videos.overview: An orphan from a galactic backwater crosses the cosmos to take a job at a ruthless mega-corporation in the hopes of reuniting with the girl he loves.

videos.title: Mega Man: Start
videos.overview: As the corrupted creations of genius inventor Dr. Light rampage through Mega City, the humblest of his inventions dreams of fighting for everlasting peace.

videos.title: Exodus: Odyssey
videos.overview: A mechanic traverses the galactic frontier, racing against time in search of his runaway daughter.

videos.title: Spelunky: Tally
videos.overview: A pair of explorers ponder their purpose in a subterranean world where everything wants to kill them. Repeatedly.

videos.title: Concord: Tale of the Implacable
videos.overview: Captain Cassidy's crew of Freegunners is about to pull off the biggest heist of their lives – now there's only a deadly armada and a cosmos-sundering space storm between them and freedom.

videos.title: Honor of Kings: The Way of All Things
videos.overview: An orphaned prodigy challenges the all-knowing artificial intelligence that rules his city.

videos.title: Playtime: Fulfillment
videos.overview: Courier O is stuck in the endless drudgery of a point-chasing grind, but when a mysterious figure entrusts her with a strange package, O discovers that powerful people are determined to get their hands on it.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 8 nominations total
